name: WANTED: Murkdeep!
objectiveText: Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep . The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water. Report the death of Murkdeep to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.   Murkdeep slain  ( 1 )

comments.body:
First of all you must kill the 6 Murloc Warriors and Hunters that are by the town with 3 huts.

That spawns 3 lv 13 Coastrunners.

Take them out to spawn 2 lv 15 Warriors.

Take them out to spawn Murkdeep (lv 19) and a Warrior (lv 15).

My alt, being a rogue, sapped Murkdeep and murdered the Warrior. I healed myself with a bandage in time for Murkdeep to come to his senses. A Gouge, Backstab, Sinister Strike, and an Eviscerate later Murkdeep was dead.
replies: Twice recently I have been lucky enough to find Murkdeep wading in the water for me. Quick and easy.

comments.body:
Spent some time analyzing this last night.

Steps in detail:

Find the camp - it is the only one with huts in Darkshore.
Clear all mob spawn.
**Stand near the camp fire in the middle** - For those people who have repeatedly cleared the camp, this step is what you were missing.
Clear adds from water.
Clear adds from water again.
Take Murkdeep's life.
Profit.

Also note that the camp itself repops pretty fast so be quick.
He's at roughly 35,74.

comments.body: Murkdeep can be found at 36, 76 (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=10323) on the shore, surrounded by Murloc hunters, warriors, and coastrunners in a small camp.

[Shaman 15]

For those of you that do not know, advice from hunters should only be tried by hunters (and maybe warlocks). For a very long time now, hunters have been known as the "solo class" because they really have two players: the hunter and a meat shield (pet).

Note This!! - Any time a hunter says it can be done and you are not a hunter, it is a totaly different game.

This said, I did complete the quest as a level 15 Shaman. Here's how..

As said above, pulling the mobs in singles or smaller groups is correct. The problem is when facing Murkdeep. Several quests in the game will require you to kill a "named" NPC and he/she will almost always have "bodyguards". This one is no exception. A hunter above states "easy to solo lvl 12hunter LOL kiting ftw :D" and he's full of it. Post the video friend. I would bet he completed the quest in the same way or very similar to the other hunters, sending in pet on a few pulled mobs and letting his "meat shield" take the damage. Kiting is not easy and with the new daze mechanics, I would bet all my gold that he did not "kite" the mobs (probably doesen't know what kiting is).

If you have any ranged abilities, start off with those on Murkdeep. I used Lightning after placing a Stoneclaw totem about half way in my cast range. Draenei have a racial HoT (heal over time) that I used after a nice big Nuke on the Murkdeep and I plop a Fire Nova and after plop a Flamtoung. At this point I was at a bit more than half health, my HoT was gone and the bodyguards were about to rush me. I self heal to fill my bar.

Murkdeep is now at 1/4th health, but it's not over yet. I've not done any damage to the guards, so new totems would be toast and Claw tot is on cooldown. I don't have much mana, so I Flame shock, recharge my shield and plop a Stoneskin. The entire time I'm backing up to make distance between me and the guards, I had to be careful not to evade the mobs (another reason kiting is hard here), but being on the brink of evading mobs can be a good thing. A final Earth Shock kills Murkdeep, I now have only 14% health and the guards are wicked pissed. I drop my Earthbind and turn-tail, running further away from the mobs origional spawn point. Sure enough, they evade.

I run up to the corpse of Murkdeep, grab my loot and eat/drink atop his fallen body. Success!

Good Luck and Death to Murkdeep!

If you save this until level 20 as a druid, it can be a snap. Once Murkdeep spawns, root the additional murloc that accompanies him, then run as far as you can get before he leashes - this will ensure that you will have enough time to kill Murkdeep before entangling roots releases and you have another add to deal with. If you can put a dot up on Murkdeep (Moonfire, etc), it will be helpful since it will have a chance to kill him while he flees so you don't have to deal with two mobs if he decided to run back while you are engaged with the rooted one. I used kitty form to kill him, but you can probably also use bear or humanoid form just as well. Good luck =)

Read Pekky's comment with some amusement. My single biggest complaint (and one of only a few) about the quests is that Blizzard chooses (that's right, they've discussed it at length, and even explained their choice in an email to me) NOT to separately designate solo quests from group quests, except in a few specific cases. Discovering which quest is soloable and which can only be done by a group (at the appropriate level) is part of the fun. Don't want those Spirit Healers to get too lonely!

I can see their point to a certain extent: they want us to ask other players about the quests and maybe get a little assistance.

comments.body:
I solo'd this as a 17 Druid. Not impossible by any means, but pretty hard.

At (36,77) I started at the north end of the camp and killed a couple of the 17's at that end of the camp. You don't have to empty the camp, but you do have to kill some of them.

Then a group of about 3 lvl 12's and a 16 appeared in the center. What I did was stand far away, blast one of the weak ones as fast as i could until it died, then ran away before the rest of the group killed me. Then go back and repeat against the smaller group.

When that group dies, another group of about 3 16-17's appear. I did the same thing. stand far away, blast one as fast as i could until it died, then ran away. Repeat until that group is dead.

Then Murkdeep appears with a bodyguard. Did the same thing to his bodyguard, then came back and got Murkdeep.

If you want to be on the safeside, bring a potion or two, and some food/drink always helps.

In case anyone was wondering, I didn't really have to deal with any of the original guys respawning (possibly only 1). After all i didn't wipe out the whole camp or anything.  This whole thing probably took about 10 minutes. (I know it sounds longer, but it's not that bad.)
